page: Google Cloud Platform n2-highmem-8 is an x86_64 server instance optimized for memory-intensive general-purpose computing. It is powered by a 2.8 GHz Intel Xeon processor provisioned with 4 dedicated physical cores, executing 8 vCPUs across 2 threads per core. The CPU configuration includes 32 KB of L1 data cache per core, 1.0 MB of L2 cache per core, and a shared 33 MB L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX, AVX-512F, and AVX-512 VNNI, alongside hardware-accelerated AES cryptography and bit-manipulation extensions (BMI2, ADX). The system does not bundle local disk storage or hardware GPUs, and complimentary public IPv4 addresses are omitted.

Memory provisioning is a core attribute of this instance, delivering 64.0 GB of system RAM, which yields an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio. Uncached large-block (256 MB) memory read operations reach 52.02 GB/sec, while write bandwidth sustains 40.05 GB/sec. Cached small-block (16 KB) memory throughput reaches 413.33 GB/sec, supporting a PassMark memory score of 2496.69.

Benchmark outcomes demonstrate mid-tier performance across varied computational tasks. The instance achieved a Geekbench multi-core score of 4476.0 and a single-core score of 1178.0, with a software compilation rating of 6783.0. In synthetic compute evaluations, PassMark recorded an overall CPU score of 8349.76, an encryption test value of 3414.27, and an extended instructions score of 6443.61. Conversely, complex arithmetic tasks such as ray tracing (5504.0) and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression (28.07 GB/sec) scored in the lower quartile of comparative benchmarks.

Workload evaluation displays solid capabilities in stateful memory operations, achieving 7.13 million Redis SET operations per second, a PassMark database operations rating of 2913.78, and a static web serving rate of 7.05 GB/sec. However, machine learning inference displays significant tradeoffs: 7B parameter models produce only 10.36 tokens/sec during prompt processing and 6.34 tokens/sec during generation, falling into the bottom percentile. The n2-highmem-8 is qualitatively well-aligned for caching tiers, in-memory databases, enterprise application servers, and intermediate data processing environments requiring large memory overhead rather than raw accelerator power.
description: Google Cloud Platform n2-highmem-8 is an x86_64 general-purpose compute instance configured with 8 vCPUs and 64.0 GB of RAM, backed by a 4-core, 2.8 GHz Intel Xeon processor with hyper-threading enabled. Featuring 8.0 GB of memory per vCPU and AVX-512 vector extensions, it achieves large-block uncached read speeds of 52.02 GB/sec and 40.05 GB/sec for writes. The instance bundles no local storage or GPUs. Benchmark results place it primarily in the mid-range for general multi-threaded compute, showing a PassMark CPU score of 8349.76, a Geekbench multi-core score of 4476.0, and 7.13 million Redis SET operations per second. While machine learning inference on larger models reveals severe processing limitations, its generous RAM-to-CPU ratio delivers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound tasks such as Redis caching, relational databases, web servers, and intermediate ETL data pipelines.
